title: HH 211 (NIRCam image, cropped)
object: HH 211 bipolar outflow from a Class 0 protostar (Perseus)
credit: ESA/Webb, NASA, CSA, T. Ray (Dublin Institute for Advanced Studies)
license: CC BY 4.0 (ESA/Webb image use policy, https://esawebb.org/copyright/); credit must be shown unaltered
band: Near-infrared composite: 1.62 and Fe II 1.64 um (purple), methane 2.1 um and H2 3.23 um (blue), PAH 3.35 um (cyan), CO 4.6 um (green), CO 4.66 um (orange), H2 4.7 um (red)
image_kind: processed multi-filter composite with assigned (false) colours; not a natural-colour image
processing_notes: Colour assignment as listed on the source page; no further processing by this project.
derivative_operations: none: the file is used exactly as downloaded; at run time it is decoded and uploaded to the GPU as RGBA8 with mipmaps for display only
intended_use: Observation view reference panel; displayed unmodified with its credit line beside it, compared side by side with the STELLARIS procedural scene, which is labelled a conceptual visualization and not a reconstruction.
